record.content: The July 2026 USGS Transportation service returns the Convict Lake Road and Boat Launch road features plus a paved 0.34564349-mile CONVICT LAKE VIS trail. Their geometry matches the road-trail-road loop closure depicted by the official Forest Service hiking map. The south road feature intersects the paved trail endpoint within 0.4 meter; the north road and retained trail endpoints match within approximately 1.4 meters.
